result.guidanceOfficial: The calendar-year outlook for 2026 is as follows: • Gross billings growth of 3% to 4%. • Growth in the average number of WSEs of 1% to 2%. • Gross margin as a percent of gross billings of 2.70% to 2.75%. • Effective annual tax rate to remain at 26% to 27%, excluding the one-time charge related to prior-year tax credits.
